id: title:VojtechBartos:never unfurl links in slack connect channels

review.posthog_relevance: Slack app backend route handling and shared link unfurl behavior
review.reason: The change modifies the Slack app backend route handler P1.F1. P1.F1.H1 adds a guard to locally handle shared links without forwarding, while P1.F1.H2 removes a guard that previously blocked unapproved external channels. P1.F2.H1 updates the corresponding test expectations. This represents a substantive, bounded change to the Slack app's shared link handling and channel approval, a
review.uncertainty: The exact impact of removing the approval guard and the specific behavior of the new local-return path are not fully demonstrated by the supplied hunks alone; no adoption or incident avoidance is inferred.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are cited. No score assigned. No adoption, incident, or benefit inferred. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a guard: if event_type is link_shared and channel is an external shared channel, log and return ROUTE_HANDLED_LOCALLY, bypassing downstream lookup and cross-region forwarding.
observations.posthog_connection: Slack app backend route handler P1.F1; this hunk P1.F1.H1 adds a local-return path before any region lookup or cross-region forwarding, preventing the event from reaching downstream handlers. This could preserve the intended behavior of not unfurling shared links into external channels, regardless of the region. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Removes a guard that checked whether an external shared channel was approved, and returned ROUTE_HANDLED_LOCALLY if not approved.
observations.posthog_connection: Slack app backend route handler P1.F1; this hunk P1.F1.H2 removes a guard that previously returned ROUTE_HANDLED_LOCALLY when an external shared channel was not approved. This could change behavior: shared links could now proceed to downstream handlers even if the channel is not approved. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Changes a parameterized test case: the ext_approved case now expects expect_unfurled=False, and the test name is updated to reflect that the unfurl never reaches an external channel.
observations.posthog_connection: Slack app backend tests P1.F2; this hunk P1.F2.H1 changes the expected outcome of the ext_approved test, indicating the unfurl should not reach an external channel. This could support the behavior change in P1.F1, but no score assigned.
